title: 7.3 Workspaces and .xfproj file
author: Unknown
content: Has anyone worked yet with workspaces (loading/extracting) using a .xfproj file? I am trying to moved a dashboard maintenance unit (DMU) out of the default workspace into a new one.
solution_text: Examples of using Workspace with an .XFProj file: Everything in a Workspace, Everything in a DMU in a Workspace, Everything in the Default Workspace, Everything in the Default Workspace with the DMU specified.
